basic_details.job_title: SCERT Project Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The post of Project Officer at SCERT is open only to the academic staff of Govt. Schools, Govt. Colleges, Govt. Teacher Training Institutions and Govt Academic Institutes in the State, for appointment on other duty basis. Candidates need an MSc and Ph.D in any Science discipline from a recognized university, teaching experience at the school level and expertise in quantitative data analysis and its application to education-related research. The bio-data, with attested copies of certificates and an NOC, must reach the Director, SCERT, Poojappura, Thiruvanathapuram on or before 18 November 2026.

qualification.details: MSc & Ph.D in any Science discipline from a recognized university. Teaching experience at the school level. Expertise in quantitative data analysis and its application to education-related research.

how_to_apply: The application is a bio-data sent on paper. It must reach SCERT on or before 18 November 2026.
Prepare a bio-data stating the details of your qualifications, experience and so on.
Attach attested copies of your certificates.
Attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Head of the Department/Authority concerned.
Write the superscription "Application for Appointment for the post of Project Officer" on the envelope in which the application is enclosed.
Send the application to: Director, SCERT, Poojappura, Thiruvanathapuram, so that it reaches on or before 18 November 2026.
NOC from the Head of the Department/Authority concerned
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be rejected. All correspondences in this regard will be made through e-mail only. An application without the NOC from the Head of the Department/Authority concerned does not meet the notice's requirements.

content_sections.heading: About SCERT Kerala Project Officer
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Director of SCERT, whose office is at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram. It is dated 10 November 2026 and fills the post of Project Officer from among serving academic staff of Government institutions in the State. The notice says that further details are available on the SCERT website, scert.kerala.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only academic staff of Govt. Schools, Govt. Colleges, Govt. Teacher Training Institutions and Govt Academic Institutes in the State may apply. The post is filled on other duty basis. MSc & Ph.D in any Science discipline from a recognized university. Teaching experience at the school level. Expertise in quantitative data analysis and its application to education-related research. Research experience in a national level scientific research institution. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SCERT Kerala Project Officer
content_sections.text: The application is a bio-data sent on paper. It must reach SCERT on or before 18 November 2026. Prepare a bio-data stating the details of your qualifications, experience and so on. Attach attested copies of your certificates. Attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Head of the Department/Authority concerned. Write the superscription "Application for Appointment for the post of Project Officer" on the envelope in which the application is enclosed. Send the application to: Director, SCERT, Poojappura, Thiruvanathapuram, so that it reaches on or before 18 November 2026. Bio-data stating qualifications, experience etc. Attested copies of certificates NOC from the Head of the Department/Authority concerned

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. All correspondence about this recruitment will be made through e-mail only.
